title: Profile
description: One per user: display preferences. The id is the user's Cognito sub, set by the server from the verified token.

default_rest_seconds.description: Rest timer used when neither exercise_rest_seconds nor the routine sets one.

exercise_rest_seconds.description: Rest timer chosen per exercise, keyed by ExerciseRef (builtin:<slug> or a custom exercise's uuid). Applies every time the user does that exercise. Precedence: exercise_rest_seconds, then the routine's rest_seconds, then default_rest_seconds. Keys for deleted custom exercises may remain; readers ignore them.
